novelty_flags.label: thm:honest-spectral-band / literature survey
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey misses Ai, Huang, and Zhang (2026, arXiv:2602.01595), which proves uniform bootstrap and bias-control bands for nonparametric continuous-treatment causal functions and is a closer comparator than the binary-treatment Lee--Okui--Whang band.

soundness_flags.label: ass:conditional-code-radius
soundness_flags.one_line: Jin--Mackey--Syrgkanis use an unconditional L^s(P_X) supplied-nuisance ball; the proposed uniform-in-v conditional-L1 bound is a stronger new condition, not the cited standard variant.

soundness_flags.label: ass:conditional-code-radius / def:spectral-law-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The law class is defined by the error of the particular supplied procedure bar g_n; state a primitive law-level conditional estimability property and pass the actual code as a construction input instead.

soundness_flags.label: epsbar / def:accepted-contour-bank
soundness_flags.one_line: epsbar is said to be certified by the contour bank while the bank is constructed using epsbar, leaving the positive fixed-error radius circular rather than independently specified or derived from primitives.

soundness_flags.label: prop:exact-code-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: For the allowed odd k (for example k=3), symmetric Gaussian--Rademacher treatment noise has k-th cumulant zero and hence is outside Pspec; the claimed universal reduction requires k even or an explicitly asymmetric non-Gaussian submodel.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The theorem assumes independent sub-Gaussian treatment noise and controls errors through supplied nuisance radii epsilon_1 and epsilon_2 in its structure-agnostic class; it does not state a sup_v E[|bar g_n-g_0| | V=v] conditional-L1 condition.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Applied Econometrics 32(7), 2017 journal record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article is a doubly robust CATE-function procedure with a uniform confidence band, built around nuisance-dependent pseudo-outcome inference.

source_verification_receipts.version: Scandinavian Journal of Statistics 27(4), 2000 journal record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives maximum-deviation asymptotics and simultaneous confidence bands for varying-coefficient functions via local-polynomial methods.
The paper derives a Hölder-model minimax CATE estimation rate and a rate-optimal local-polynomial estimator; it is not an honest-band expected-width theorem.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1303.7152 preprint, used only to corroborate the cited result
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The generic construction derives honest bands from Gaussian approximation, critical-value control, and anti-concentration conditions; it does not supply the spectral indexed linearization proposed here.

The preprint develops nonparametric continuous-treatment causal-function estimation, uniform Bahadur representations, bootstrap uniform confidence bands, and data-driven bias control using estimated minimum-variance balancing weights.

Repair the exact-code subexperiment for every allowed k by either fixing k=4 or specifying an asymmetric bounded sub-Gaussian noise family with the chosen k-th cumulant bounded away from zero, then display the regression reduction.
Add Ai--Huang--Zhang (2026) to related work and state a precise non-overlap proposition: its estimated-weight requirements versus the proposed fixed supplied-code/no-outcome-learner contour regime.
